query: How do I check if a person is a Singapore Permanent Resident (PR)?
reference_answer: You may check the validity of the Re-entry Permit (REP) held by the person alongside a valid Identity Card (IC) or Digital IC (if available).
answer: To check if someone is a Singapore Permanent Resident (PR), look for the PR card, which has a blue chip with a unique ID number. Alternatively, you can visit the Immigration & Checkpoints Authority (ICA) website to verify their status online. [Document 1]
